title: Require Domain Operation Implementation Type Boundary
forbids: operation entrypoints, strategy leaves, and rules deriving shared working types from an operation contract input/output envelope or re-exporting contract authority
why: The contract file is the sole composition owner for complete operation input and output envelopes. Implementation code, including semantic strategy leaves, consumes admitted values through private working shapes; only smaller reusable primitives and cohesive subentities come from nearest-owner model atoms. Moving the whole envelope or an artifact payload into atoms would preserve the same hidden coupling under a different path.
remediate: Keep algorithm-private Params/Result types local, move only genuinely shared primitives or cohesive subentities to model/atoms, delete OpTypeBagOf and contract input/output projections, and reserve the default contract import for runtime binding. Do not create payload-shaped atoms as substitutes for operation or artifact authority.
message: Operation implementation types must use private working shapes and smaller atoms, not contract envelopes or artifact-shaped model aliases.
